multiplier: 1 unless instrument metadata supplies a verified alternate multiplier
oi_unit: workbook says 100 lots; runtime must compare either lots or units explicitly and not confuse OI threshold with order quantity
partial_fill_handling: generic internal-paper PositionCycle handles confirmed exchange units; no APS splitting for one-lot S22
pnl_formula: short option realized gross P&L = (entry_fill_price - exit_fill_price) * confirmed_exchange_quantity * multiplier
